clue.text: The drink divine!

parts.note: read as praise for a lovely glass of wine, but it describes the Roman god of wine, a deity of drink

explanation.surface: Someone toasting an excellent drink.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman god of wine is literally a divine figure presiding over drink.

clue.text: Got accommodation on ship that's stopped in dock

definitions.meaning: was given a bunk or cabin aboard a vessel
of a vessel, moored at a quay

explanation.surface: A passenger found a cabin on a vessel that had moored.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' is a link between the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: A berth is both a sleeping place aboard a vessel and a mooring place in harbour.

clue.text: Unfriendly ailment…

definitions.meaning: a mild illness such as a cold caught from cold weather

explanation.definitionFit: A cold manner and a feverish cold are both called by this word.

clue.text: To show signs of sickness what a drag!

definitions.meaning: a drag here is a hard pull, a big tug

explanation.surface: Feeling queasy is such a nuisance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drag' reads as 'what a bore' but means a strong pull; 'To' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To retch is to heave, and a heave is a mighty pull.

clue.text: Breaks into shakes

explanation.surface: Someone starts trembling.
explanation.walkthrough: To shiver is an old verb for shatter; 'into' links the two.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiver means both to splinter into pieces and to tremble.

clue.text: Set out early to pick up broadcasts

definitions.text: Set out early to pick up broadcasts

parts.words: Set out early to pick up broadcasts
parts.note: reads as leaving home early to collect something, but describes a primitive radio receiver, the set put out in the early days of wireless

explanation.surface: Someone heading off early to collect some broadcasts.
explanation.walkthrough: A crystal set was the simple radio receiver of the 1920s, using a mineral detector and no battery.
explanation.definitionFit: The early radio receivers were called crystal sets after the mineral detector they used.

clue.text: White sticks, generally, but no help to blind people

definitions.text: White sticks, generally, but no help to blind people

parts.words: White sticks, generally, but no help to blind people
parts.note: reads as the canes blind people carry, but describes wax lights, usually white sticks, whose light is useless to the sightless

explanation.surface: A remark about the white canes used by blind people.
explanation.definitionFit: Wax tapers are usually white sticks giving light, which cannot help those who cannot see.

clue.text: May snatch it off a sailor

indicators.note: off means the letters of the words before it are out of order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl named May grabs something from a seaman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges MAY SNATCH; 'it' and 'a' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who sails a pleasure boat is a kind of sailor.

clue.text: Stop being like an ant in an uplifted fashion

indicators.note: in says the lifted word sits inside the insect word

parts.note: termites are insects that look like ants, once called white ants

indicators.note: in a down clue, uplifted means the little word is turned upwards, read backwards

explanation.surface: Advice to stop behaving like a busy insect in a lofty way.
explanation.walkthrough: Termites are often called white ants, so 'being like an ant' is a fair description; 'uplifted' suits a down clue, and 'fashion' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To terminate something is to bring it to an end.

clue.text: Stay-at-homes!

parts.note: reads as homebodies who never go out, but describes people who stay at other people's homes for rent

explanation.surface: A jibe at people who never go out.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying tenants who live in someone else's house stay at homes not their own.

clue.text: The wreckage of allotment Doctor Muni beheaded in

indicators.note: placed at the end of the clue, in says the doctored remains go inside the allotment word

parts.note: an allotment is a share given out, a ration

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters after it are rearranged
beheaded means the first letter of the following word, Muni, is cut off

explanation.surface: A garden allotment wrecked by a doctor called Muni.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beheaded' removes the M from Muni, 'Doctor' rearranges what is left to UIN, and 'in' sets it after the first letter of the allotment word. 'The' and 'of' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruination is the state of being wrecked, the same as wreckage in an abstract sense.

clue.text: Changing colour after smoking-not going green, though!

definitions.text: Changing colour after smoking-not going green, though!

parts.words: Changing colour after smoking-not going green, though!
parts.note: reads as a nauseous first-time smoker, but describes food preserved by smoke, which darkens, and also someone made well, so no longer green

explanation.surface: A novice smoker whose face changes colour without turning green.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat or fish preserved by smoking darkens, and a patient made well no longer looks sickly green.

clue.text: He took in Miss Terry, this Greek

indicators.note: took in means the first word swallows the second, holding it inside

parts.note: Ellen Terry was a celebrated Victorian actress

explanation.surface: A man gave a home to an actress who turns out to be Greek.
explanation.walkthrough: Ellen Terry was a famous English stage actress of the late 1800s; 'this' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hellene is a native of Greece, the Greeks' own name for themselves.

clue.text: Bars them crossing in it

parts.note: reads as a ban on crossing, but describes a framework in which strips of wood or metal criss-cross

explanation.surface: A notice forbidding people from crossing.
explanation.definitionFit: A trellis or grille is made of strips crossing one another diagonally.

clue.text: As dingo is ill, one'll tell you what's wrong with him

definitions.text: one'll tell you what's wrong with him

indicators.note: ill means the letters of the words before it are in poor shape and need rearranging

explanation.surface: A vet examining a sick wild dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ill' rearranges AS DINGO to DIAGNO, and IS follows unchanged.
explanation.definitionFit: A vet's or doctor's identification of an illness tells you what ails the patient.

clue.text: Queen will hate this

parts.note: a monarch speaking as we, the royal plural, voices loathing in a formal way

explanation.surface: A prediction that the monarch will dislike something.
explanation.definitionFit: To loathe or detest something is to feel intense hatred for it.

clue.text: Place of entertainment used by the nocturnal mugger

definitions.meaning: a venue open late for dancing and drinks

explanation.surface: A venue frequented by a robber who works after dark.
explanation.definitionFit: A late-opening dance venue, or read as two words, a cudgel used after dark.

clue.text: Money is tight, up to a point

parts.note: tight with money means mean, stingy
S, south, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Money is in short supply, but only to some extent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' and 'up to a' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's means are their income or wealth.

clue.text: Hide in a long, narrow way!

definitions.text: Hide in a long, narrow way!

parts.words: Hide in a long, narrow way!
parts.note: reads as concealing oneself in an alley, but describes leather, hide, cut into a long narrow strip

explanation.surface: Advice to conceal oneself in a long narrow alley.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip of leather used as a lace or whip is a long narrow piece of hide.

clue.text: In spite of it, the second half is imagined

parts.note: though means despite, in spite of

indicators.note: the second half of a two-letter word is just its final letter

explanation.surface: Despite it, the latter part is just make-believe.
explanation.definitionFit: Something imagined has been thought up in the mind.

clue.text: Red man not about to get decoration

indicators.note: about means the letters of the words before it are moved around

explanation.surface: A man in red is not going to be honoured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges RED MAN NOT; 'to get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An ornament or embellishment is a decoration.

clue.text: Picked up by one's ears!

parts.note: reads as being lifted by the ears like a rabbit, but describes sound that can be heard

explanation.surface: Someone lifted up by the ears.
explanation.definitionFit: A sound that can be heard is caught by the ears.

clue.text: Given a command in the army, for instance

definitions.text: Given a command in the army, for instance

parts.words: Given a command in the army, for instance
parts.note: reads as being put in charge of troops, but describes being told what to do, as soldiers are

explanation.surface: Someone given charge of troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers are commanded, told by superiors what to do.

clue.text: Not term for outrage and torture

indicators.note: outrage is read as a violent act done to the words, which leaves their letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Outrage at something that is not a fixed sentence, and at cruelty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outrage' rearranges NOT TERM; 'for' and 'and' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Torment is severe suffering, much like torture.

clue.text: Dropped, timed to explode

indicators.note: explode means the letters before it blow apart and land in a new order

explanation.surface: A bomb dropped with a timer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something left out has been dropped.

clue.text: The French of Paris, about to show great depression

parts.note: de is the French word for of

indicators.note: about means the letters of Paris are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: A Parisian in gloom, expressed in French.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges PARIS to SPAIR; 'The' and 'to show' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Despair is utter hopelessness, a deep depression of spirits.

clue.text: Misses refuse containers

explanation.surface: Girls refuse to hold something.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a skip is a large open metal container for builders' rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass over something is to skip it, and a big rubbish bin is a skip.

clue.text: Saw US lawman in time

indicators.note: in says the lawman sits inside the period word

parts.note: an age is a long period of time
a DA is a district attorney in the United States

explanation.surface: An American lawman seen in good time.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or proverb.

clue.text: Galahad found it had been drunk from

definitions.text: Galahad found it had been drunk from

parts.words: Galahad found it had been drunk from
parts.note: Sir Galahad, the Arthurian knight, achieved the quest for the cup used at the Last Supper

explanation.surface: A knight discovers a cup that has been used.
explanation.definitionFit: The holy cup sought by Arthur's knights was the vessel Christ drank from at the Last Supper.

clue.text: Advance an idea for stopping one, in a way

definitions.text: Advance an idea for stopping one, in a way

parts.words: Advance an idea for stopping one, in a way
parts.note: reads as putting forward a proposal, but advance is a noun: a barrier across a road is a way of stopping an advance

explanation.surface: Someone proposing a plan to halt something.
explanation.definitionFit: A street barrier is erected to halt an advancing force on a road.

clue.text: Afraid to move like this

parts.note: reads as someone frozen with fear, but describes the shaking a frightened person does

explanation.surface: Someone too scared to move.
explanation.definitionFit: Quaking or shaking is how a frightened body moves.

clue.text: Over savoury food dish then served

definitions.text: Over savoury food dish then served

parts.words: Over savoury food dish then served
parts.note: in an old formal dinner the sweet course came once the savoury course was over

explanation.surface: A meal where a dish is served after the savoury course.
explanation.definitionFit: The sweet course follows the savoury ones at the end of a meal.
